{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
display(data.head())

display(data.info())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("Unique revenue values:", data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

display(qa_orders.head())"}
